description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'PolicyIdNotAllowedException' used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It represents an error condition when a Thing modification contains prohibited Policy ID information. The class includes static methods for creating instances from messages and JSON, a builder pattern for constructing the exception, and relevant metadata like error code and message templates.
